title.rendered: Your Body Is the Temple of the Holy Spirit: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: Your body is the temple of the Holy Spirit. The dwelling of God is no longer a building. It is a person. If you belong to Christ, that person is you.

content.rendered:
Your body is the temple of the Holy Spirit. The dwelling of God is no longer a building in Jerusalem. It is a person in Jesus Christ. And if you belong to Him, that person is you. Walk like you know whose dwelling you are.

The Gospel For Today | Friday, May 29, 2026

Today’s Scripture

“Or do you not know that your body is the temple of the Holy Spirit who is in you, whom you have from God, and you are not your own? For you were bought at a price; therefore glorify God in your body and in your spirit, which are God’s.”
1 Corinthians 6:19–20 (NKJV)

Today’s Message

For centuries the temple in Jerusalem was the most sacred space on earth. Inside, behind a thick curtain, was the Most Holy Place where the presence of God dwelled in fire and cloud. Common people were not allowed to enter. The high priest only went in once a year, with blood, trembling. The temple was the place. The place was the dwelling.

Then Jesus came. He died. The curtain tore from top to bottom. The dwelling left the building. And on the day of Pentecost, when the Holy Spirit fell on the disciples, the temple of God relocated. The dwelling is no longer in a building. The dwelling is in a person. And if you belong to Christ, that person is you.

Hear this today. Somebody needs to hear it this morning. You are not just a person God loves from a distance. You are a person God lives in. The same Spirit who filled the Most Holy Place in Jerusalem fills the body you carried into this day. Stop walking around like you have no value. Stop letting people, voices, addictions, traumas, and lies tell you that you are common. You are the dwelling place of the Most High God.

This is why Paul writes what he does. You are not your own. Now hear that the way Paul meant it. Not as a slogan of slavery. As a declaration of dignity. You belong to the One who paid the highest price the universe has ever known. You were bought with blood. Not silver. Not gold. The blood of Jesus Christ poured out at Calvary. Whatever the world has done with you, whatever you have done with yourself, that price has been paid and the receipt is the Holy Spirit inside you.

And to the one reading this who has been disrespected, used, abused, or made to feel disposable—hear it again. The world’s treatment of your body has never changed what God’s Spirit has declared it to be. He calls it a temple. He calls you holy. He has set you apart. Your past does not erase your present designation. The Spirit of the living God dwells in you, and what He dwells in, He sanctifies.

So today, pull your shoulders back. Walk through this day knowing what walks in you. Honor the temple. With what you put into it. With how you use it. With how you let others treat it. With how you rest it, fuel it, and present it. Not as legalism. As honor. The dwelling of God deserves honor, and that dwelling is you.

Prayer

Father, thank You for the staggering reality that my body is Your dwelling place. Forgive me for every way I have treated this temple as common. Set me free from every voice that has told me I am worthless or disposable. Help me honor what You have made holy. Help me walk through this day in the dignity of one who knows Whose I am. In Jesus’ name. Amen.

Declaration

My body is the temple of the Holy Spirit. I was bought at a price—the blood of Jesus Christ. I am not disposable. I am not common. I am the dwelling place of the living God. I walk through this day in the dignity of the temple. I honor what He has made holy.
